overview.text: Chukwudubem "Chiedu" Egbuniwe is an IT professional and consultant. He says he has volunteered with the city for over two decades, including serving on the LGBTQ+ Commission, the WeHo40 Action Team and arts grant panels. He supports using state law SB 79 to allow mid-rise housing near transit. He has proposed a Transit Oriented Development Alternative Plan focusing mixed-use development along commercial corridors. He opposes using Flock Safety cameras. He opposes the Fountain Avenue Streetscape Project in its current form. He supports adding bike lanes to Fountain Avenue after the 2028 Olympics.
